scripts.logic:examples: M="$(cd "${IMMZ_HOME:-../smart-immunizations}" && pwd)/tools/node/makeExample.js" && for f in input/tests/plandefinition/*/*.yaml; do (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && node "$M" "$(basename "$f")") || exit 1; done
scripts.logic:generate: G=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p $G/output/libraries $G/output/cql $G/output/plandefinitions && R=$PWD && C="$(cd "${IMMZ_HOME:-../smart-immunizations}" && pwd)/tools/node/processDTSchedule.js" && cd $G && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "Hepatitis B" 1 7 11 D18S "BirthDose" && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "Polio" 1 17-21 11 D18S "BOPVPlusIPV" && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "DTP" 1 7-9 12 D18S "OnTimeStart" && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "Measles" 1 7-8 9 D18S "OngoingTransmission" && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "Malaria" 1 7-10 9 D18S "" && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "HPV" 1 26-28 12 D18S "SingleDose" && node "$C" "$R/input/decision-logic/IMMZ DAK_decision-support logic.xlsx" "DTP" 1 98-102 12 D18S "TdWCBA" && cp output/libraries/*.fsh $R/input/fsh/libraries/ && cp output/plandefinitions/*.fsh $R/input/fsh/plandefinitions/ && echo "CQL skeletons in $G/output/cql: complete them from the pseudocode, as tools/antigenchecklist.md says"

_comment: As in litlfred/smart-immunizations: the mounted code layers as workspaces (they import each other by package name), and `bun run cat <name>` runs a declared script wherever its instance declares it.
_comment_tools: Upstream toolchain, executed in place, never vendored (smart-base-tools, Adapting a DAK): SMART_BASE_HOME is a litlfred/smart-base checkout (l1-transcription-verbatim); IMMZ_HOME a litlfred/smart-immunizations checkout (tools/node: processDTSchedule.js, makeExample.js). CI pins both by commit.
